text:
mohan: Heads-up: scheduling a dawn soft-drain maintenance in apac-south (04:20-06:20 UTC) to apply NIC microcode + small GPU microcode patch. Goal is to reduce intermittent DMA stalls. We'll do micro-batches to keep KV cache warm.

tara: thanks. expected usable GPU impact? any pools to flag?

mohan: estimate ~5-8% usable capacity dip at peak. Affected pools: aurora-apac and mercury-apac. We've flagged 3 enterprise tenants in the runbook.

liz: propose two disjoint canaries on separate ToRs, then 1-rack micro-batches (~7-9m) to limit cold-hit. That should catch ToR-level regressions.

mohan: agreed. canaries: rack-2 and rack-14 (different uplinks). flow: cordon -> evict noncritical -> soft-reboot -> smoke probes -> small kv-seed -> resume.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created (#8337) by mohan. Reminder set for 45m and 15m before window.

finops: if we push traffic cross-region (to eu or us) for fallback, rough egress delta? need figure for finance.

liz: current apac-south outbound ~480GB/h. If we shift 2h to eu at $0.095/GB -> 480GB * 2 * 0.095 = ~$91. Add 25% buffer for retries/double-serving => ~$114. Tag flows with maint=8337.

tara: network note: rack-14 ToR had a partial fan recal last month; that's why it's a canary. If we see asymmetric packet retrans or errors, abort and isolate the ToR.

mohan: failure criteria: smoke p99 > baseline*1.5 OR error rate >1.5% OR sustained TCP retrans above threshold. Abort steps: stop sequence, uncordon last micro-batch, revert routing weights, trigger emergency kv-seed, page infra lead.

liz: autoscaler tweak request: set max-surge +5% and increase scale-up aggressiveness for 20m after each canary to help absorb soft-evac.

mohan: added to runbook. Also adding temporary routing override to prefer eu for routes with slo>=99.9 during the heaviest phase; will revoke after window.

ops-bot: 15m preflight reminder will post to #oncall and tenant-notify channels.

tara: who owns smoke tests? can someone validate embeddings p99 and gen tail-latency?

liz: I'll own embeddings p99; mohan will own gen tail. We'll post quick snapshots in thread during the run.

finops: please label egress with "maint=8337" and include a tracing header so finance can reconcile. Approve up to $150 for this maintenance; alert me if forecasted spend exceeds that.

mohan: runbook excerpt: ```
04:00 UTC - preflight: telemetry checks, reserve 10% slots, notify teams
04:20 - canary rack-2: cordon -> soft-reboot -> smoke -> kv-seed
04:35 - canary rack-14 repeat
04:50 - micro-batches across racks (~7-9m each)
06:10 - final sweep, de-cordon, postflight metrics
```

tara: small ops nit: set client timeout to 14s during window to reduce client-side retries.

mohan: done. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/apac/soft-drain-8337 (preflight checklist). Opening calendar invite and assigning owners now. Ping here if anything risky. :white_check_mark:
